1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea trepadora, de grandes tallos, hojas trifoliadas, inflorescencia axilar y fruto aplastado, oblongo. (Fabaceae, Lablab vulgaris).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tropical bean or lablab (Fabaceae, Lablab vulgaris), a climbing herbaceous plant with large stems, trifoliate leaves, axillary inflorescence, and flattened, oblong fruit.
